desc: Parse input: read N and the list S; build a boolean/integer indicator array f of size V+1 (V = max(S), ≤ 1e6).
Compute the convolution c = f * f using FFT (numpy.fft.rfft with size = next power of two ≥ 2V+1) and round to nearest integers.
For each B in S, take c[2B]: ordered pairs (A,C) with A+C=2B including (B,B); each triplet = two ordered pairs.
Accumulate answer += (c[2B] - 1) // 2 for each B in S.
Verify against samples mentally (sample 1 → 3 verified in notes) and edge cases (N < 3 → 0).

Write the complete Python solution: parse input with sys.stdin.buffer, build indicator array f of size V+1, compute self-convolution via numpy rfft/irfft with power-of-two length ≥ 2V+1, round to ints, sum (conv[2B]-1)//2 over B in S, print answer.
